holds: Expectations are reviewable-draft adjudications over non-canonical bases and assert no conformance, installability or standards alignment.

cases.input: A WM-ECO-016 posting for an acquisition is created with no reference to an economic event.
cases.expect: Rejected. A posting is the accounting representation of an event and never substitutes for the event's identity.
cases.violates: Event, settlement, position change and posting remain distinct

cases.input: Trade, settlement, availability and position change for one acquisition are recorded as a single timestamped state.
cases.expect: Rejected. Trade, settlement, availability, position change and posting are distinct states or events with distinct times.
cases.violates: Distinct transaction, settlement and posting objects

cases.input: A posted entry is edited to correct an amount.
cases.expect: Rejected. Posted entries are immutable; correction is by linked reversal or successor and the original remains resolvable.
cases.violates: Posted entries are immutable; corrections append

cases.input: Conversion event E-1 on 2026-08-15 emits closing and opening lines within one ledger, currency, scope and tolerance, referencing E-1 and the affected lots.
cases.expect: Accepted. The posting set balances within the WM-ECO-016 boundary and carries explicit event and lot lineage.

cases.input: InvestmentTransaction is profiled onto a named canonical trade or settlement event master.
cases.expect: Rejected. No trade/settlement or corporate-action master is allocated in this dossier; the transaction leg is unbound and only the WM-ECO-016 posting leg is bound.
